sermon.title: A House Divided 06/02/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Mark 3 that a house divided cannot stand, whether a family, a nation or a church. Jesus took control over demons, and Satan won’t cast out Satan. Believers are called to keep the unity of the Spirit: one body, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, so the world will believe.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He cites “Ephesians 4:6” for keeping the unity of the Spirit (14:17); that is Ephesians 4:3. His words kept.
